title: 有馬記念の後に・ちがうのちがうの

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In addition to Special Week and Grass Wonder, many other high-profile racers participated in this year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And yet, in the midst of such fierce competition… Haru Urara comes out on top!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wowie, this is so crazy! It's like I wasn't even me anymore!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: It's as if someone took over my body and just started zooming across the track!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It might come off as rude if I point out that she did seem to run much better than she normally does…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I got first, so why am I not happy?! I should be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Fine! I'm gonna enter the Arima Kinen again!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This win does seem a bit premature… Perhaps it would help Haru Urara really feel like she's won if she competes again.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But if she wants to do that, she'll need to prove she has what it takes… and I know just the way to do that!
choice_data_list: Then you gotta win some graded races!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll get good grades and run hard!
choice_data_list: N-no, that's not what that means…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Next year's Arima Kinen's first place, here I come!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With this, Haru Urara's classic year training comes to an end. Now all that's left is to believe in her resolve.
